_header.source: PokeAPI data CSVs (github.com/PokeAPI/pokeapi data/v2/csv: moves, move_changelog); generations 1-5 moves; type / power / accuracy reverted to Gen V values
_header.method: tools/design_gen5_moves.py over two single-file downloads (no scraping); facts only (no names, no text)
_header.notes: EFFECT FACTS (effect_category, ailment, *_chance, stat_changes [{stat, stages}], healing / drain / recoil in percent, hits, turns, priority, flags, field tag, effect_id = dataset effect id) from move_meta* / move_flag_map; priority / target / effect_chance reverted to Gen V with move_changelog, the move_meta values are the current dataset values (no Gen V history in the dataset); category physical / special / status; target = the dataset target id (9 / 11 / 14 = spread, 4 / 6 / 12 = field)
